source: Tardis Binance Futures BTCUSDT 25-level snapshots and trades, 2020-09-01
models: same ridge parametric regular model, nonlinear regular-feature control, and fixed histogram-gradient-boosting breakdown comparison as the 2024 test
conventional_mapping: spread, near-touch total depth, full-book imbalance, realized volatility, trade volume, signed imbalance, square-root normalized signed flow
breakdown_mapping: far-versus-near depth, side-minimum executable quantities, sweep costs, higher norms, gradients, power-law score, profile collapse, microbursts, multiscale flow, impact exponent/convexity, and known permanence
gate: same three-part primary gate: at least 5% test MAE improvement, positive blocked disagreement-to-regular-error effect, and positive blocked breakdown-advantage effect
interpretation: This is a robustness check of the operational model-error claim, not evidence about participants' subjective beliefs.
